trial_type.Description: Brainstorm event label as released (MARK ON/OFF = clinical system marks; 'wave', 'spiking', 'spike' = authors' markers; 'PIN 1-6', 'PLON 1/2', 'PLAT 6-8' = authors' channel annotations at onset; transient_notch = filter edge artefact window)

brainstorm_time.Description: event time on the Brainstorm time axis (0 = the segment's reference event, e.g. seizure onset)

duration.Description: n/a for point events; extended events carry their length
